head_commit.message:
[Issue #8000] Update Header Designs for both Desktop and Mobile (#8423)

## Summary

Work for #8000 

## Changes proposed

- Both Mobile & Desktop
    - Removed icon from "Sign In" and "Account"
- Formatted Account Dropdown to be consistent with rest of nav dropdown
items
- Moved "Sign In" after other menu items in DOM to support more logical
keyboard navigation
- Mobile Only
    - Moved "Sign In" to burger menu
- Bolded top-level menu items (besides "Sign In") to stay consistent
with Figma
    - Matched vertical padding on non-dropdown items with dropdown items

## Context for reviewers

Design Review with Chelsea passed 2/6
Figma:
https://www.figma.com/design/bQUTJCMj0JYbAAnJQ4p4tX/Grantee-Designs-%7C-Quad-5-%7C-Simpler-Grants-2026?node-id=2005-78&t=QqntWkhaalxT6I24-1

### Testing Coverage Report (Relevant components only)
File|% Stmts|% Branch|% Funcs|% Lines|Uncovered Line #s 
---------|---------|----------|---------|---------|---------
Header.tsx|97.16|84.84|100|97.14|158,198,203
LoginButton.tsx|100|100|100|100|
NavDropdown.tsx|71.42|33.33|100|70.37|41-50
UserControl.tsx|98.11|85.71|93.75|100|181

## Validation steps

### Unauthenticated
#### Desktop (unauthenticated)
- [x] **Sign In has no icon**  
In the top-right nav, the "Sign In" link shows text only (no login
icon).
- [ ] **Sign In appears after other nav items in DOM**  
Using keyboard (Tab): focus order is Home → Search → About → Community →
… → **Sign In**. Sign In is the last focusable item before leaving the
nav.
- [x] **Sign In link works**  
Clicking "Sign In" goes to the expected login flow (e.g. Login.gov or
redirect).
#### Mobile (unauthenticated)
- [x] **Sign In is in the burger menu**  
"Sign In" is not in the top bar; it appears only when the hamburger menu
is opened (with Home, Search, About, Community, etc.).
- [x] **Sign In in menu has no icon**  
Inside the open menu, the "Sign In" item shows text only (no login
icon).
- [x] **Top-level menu items are bold (except Sign In)**  
In the open menu: Home, Search, About, Community are bold; "Sign In" is
not bold (consistent with Figma).
- [x] **Vertical padding is consistent**  
Non-dropdown items (e.g. Home, Search, Sign In) have the same vertical
padding as dropdown items (e.g. About, Community) in the mobile menu.
- [x] **Sign In link works from menu**  
  Tapping "Sign In" in the menu starts the login flow.

### Authenticated
#### Desktop (authenticated)
- [x] **Account has no icon**  
The "Account" control in the top-right shows text only (no
account-circle icon next to the label).
- [x] **Account dropdown matches other nav dropdowns**  
Account uses the same dropdown styling and behavior as About and
Community (e.g. trigger style, panel position, list styling).
- [x] **Account dropdown contents**  
Opening Account shows expected items (e.g. Account, Settings, Sign out)
with consistent formatting.
- [x] **Keyboard order**  
Tab order: Home → Search → About → Community → [Workspace if present] →
**Account**. Account is last in the nav before leaving.
- [x] **Account dropdown keyboard use**  
Can open Account with keyboard, move through items with arrow keys, and
activate with Enter/Space as with other dropdowns.
#### Mobile (authenticated)
- [x] **Account has no icon**  
The Account control (in the menu or top bar) shows text only (no
account-circle icon).
- [x] **Account in menu and dropdown styling**  
Account appears in the mobile nav (burger menu) and its dropdown/list
styling matches other nav dropdown items (About, Community, Workspace).
- [x] **Top-level menu items are bold (except Account)**  
In the open menu: Home, Search, About, Community, Workspace are bold;
Account (or its trigger) follows the same visual hierarchy as in Figma.
- [x] **Vertical padding is consistent**  
Account and other non-dropdown items have the same vertical padding as
dropdown items in the mobile menu.
- [x] **Account dropdown opens and works**  
Tapping Account opens the dropdown; Settings, Sign out, etc. work as
expected.
- [x] **Keyboard order in menu**  
With menu open, focus order is logical and Account is reachable and
usable via keyboard.

[Issue #7527] Update signature method to use submitting user email. (#8408)

## Summary

<!-- Use "Fixes" to automatically close issue upon PR merge. Use "Work
for" when UAT is required. -->
Work for #7527 

## Changes proposed

This pr changes the post population functionality of the signature form
field on application submission.

## Context for reviewers

Prior to this change, the signature form field was populated with the
